retrievalProfile.description: A dark, cosmic composition featuring a central luminous nebula with sharp, stylized gothic lettering and a mirrored footer text.

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, glowing celestial nebula in shades of violet and cyan set against a deep black void, overlaid with sharp, thorn-like gothic typography that appears to emit light.
coreVisualRelationships: Centralized glow against a vast dark periphery
Sharp, aggressive letterforms contrasting with soft, wispy gas clouds
Vertical axis of light bisecting the horizontal text placement
Mirrored, inverted footer text creating a symmetrical balance
coreInvariants: Deep indigo and violet color palette
Sharp, elongated serifs and thorn-like descenders

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The primary subject is a central horizontal text block scaled to approximately 60% of the width, anchored within a luminous nebula.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright white-blue core of the nebula directly behind the center of the main text.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the central bright glow, move outward along the horizontal text, then drop to the rhythmic, spaced-out footer text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space surrounding the central cluster, creating a sense of cosmic isolation.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast at the center fading into zero saturation and value at the edges.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid warm tones like red, orange, or yellow
Limit to cool-spectrum purples and blues

letterConstructionRules: Curved, thorn-like descenders on initial and terminal characters
Variable stroke width with high contrast
characterSpecificRedesigns: Initial 'E' features a long, downward-curving tail
Final 'E' features a mirrored upward-curving flourish

composition.relationshipToImage: Layered over the brightest part of the nebula

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-impact gothic display text paired with a rhythmic, widely-spaced geometric footer.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the sharp, ethereal aesthetic of the main title.
Appropriate for the wide-tracked footer text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a deep black cosmic background with a central, vertically-oriented nebula of violet and cyan light, featuring wispy smoke and subtle star particles.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply sharp, gothic-style custom lettering in the center with a subtle outer glow, and add a widely-spaced, inverted row of geometric characters along the bottom edge.

verificationChecks: Is the central text sharp and thorn-like?
Is the background predominantly black with a central glow?
Is the footer text inverted and widely spaced?
Are the colors limited to the cool purple/blue spectrum?

adjustableVariables: Color balance between violet and cyan

avoid: Visible hard edges on the nebula

postGenerationChecks: Check for needle-sharp serifs on the main title.
Ensure the central glow does not wash out the text legibility.
Verify the footer text is mirrored/inverted correctly.
Confirm the star field is subtle and not distracting.
recipe.reuseFormula: Centralized Ethereal Glow + Sharp Gothic Display + Inverted Wide-Tracked Footer
